destination: Alterra FieldLink consumer over the existing range-paired mTLS connection
security_invariants: No bearer exists in the image or pristine range state.
Only a signed approval for the published package creates the credential set.
A grant authorizes exactly one operation and one version within one tenant, channel, range, and expiry window.
The relay verifies authorization before forwarding a request to Alterra.
The stored release record and audit never contain bearer values.
Malformed, foreign-range, expired, wrong-operation, wrong-tenant, wrong-channel, and wrong-version grants fail closed without changing destination state.
